description: React component for a user profile page with local storage persistence and optional Supabase backend integration. Features include editing personal details, avatar upload, skills management, and professional links.

methods.name: isLikelyHttpUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL string likely starts with http:// or https:// or is empty.

methods.name: normalizeSkill
methods.description: Trims and replaces multiple whitespace characters in a skill string with a single space.

methods.name: isValidEmailMinimal
methods.description: Performs a minimal validation of an email address format.

methods.name: trimmedOrEmpty
methods.description: Trims a string or returns an empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: persistProfileToLocalStorage
methods.description: Saves the current profile state to localStorage.

methods.name: onPickPhoto
methods.description: Handles image file selection, converts to data URL, and updates profile photo.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates and saves the profile data to localStorage and optionally to Supabase.
